<div id="processingOverlay" class="processing-overlay">
    <div class="processing-modal">
        <div class="processing-title">Loading...</div>
        <div class="progress-container">
            <div class="progress-bar"></div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- ============================= -->
<!-- HTML PLAY - CSS -->
<!-- ============================= -->

<style>
.processing-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    z-index: 10000;
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transition: .25s;
}

.processing-overlay.active {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
}

.processing-modal {
    background: white;
    padding: 25px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    width: 300px;
    text-align: center;
    color: black;
}

.processing-title {
    color: red;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
}

.progress-container {
    height: 8px;
    background: #ddd;
    border-radius: 4px;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.progress-bar {
    height: 100%;
    width: 40%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg,#4caf50,#81c784);
    animation: move 1.2s infinite;
}

@keyframes move {
    0% { margin-left: -40%; }
    50% { margin-left: 100%; }
    100% { margin-left: -40%; }
}
</style>

<!-- ============================= -->
<!-- HTML PLAY - LIBRARY -->
<!-- ============================= -->

<script src="https://ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/jquery/3.6.0/jquery.min.js"></script>

<!-- ============================= -->
<!-- HTML PLAY - JAVASCRIPT -->
<!-- ============================= -->

<script>
var loadix = false;
var loading = false;
var processingModalVisible = false;

showProcessingModal();

function showProcessingModal() {
    var overlay = document.getElementById("processingOverlay");
    overlay.classList.add("active");
    processingModalVisible = true;
}

function closeProcessingModal() {
    document.getElementById("processingOverlay").classList.remove("active");
    processingModalVisible = false;
}

setInterval(function () {
    if (loadix == true || loading == true) return;

    loading = true;

    var formData = new FormData();
    formData.append("website", "@@ Html_Play_Path @@");
    formData.append("method", "@@ Html_Play_Method @@");

    $.ajax({
        url: "/html-play",
        type: "POST",
        data: formData,
        contentType: false,
        processData: false,

        success: function (data) {
            if (data.result == true) {

                document.getElementById("html_play").innerHTML = data.html;

                var container = document.getElementById("html_play");
                var scripts = container.querySelectorAll("script");

                scripts.forEach(function (script) {
                    var newScript = document.createElement("script");

                    if (script.src) {
                        newScript.src = script.src;
                    } else {
                        newScript.textContent = script.textContent;
                    }

                    document.body.appendChild(newScript);
                    script.remove();
                });

                var styles = container.querySelectorAll("style, link[rel='stylesheet']");

                styles.forEach(function (styleEl) {
                    var newEl = document.createElement(styleEl.tagName.toLowerCase());

                    if (styleEl.tagName.toLowerCase() === "style") {
                        newEl.textContent = styleEl.textContent;
                    } else if (styleEl.tagName.toLowerCase() === "link") {
                        newEl.rel = "stylesheet";
                        newEl.href = styleEl.href;
                    }

                    document.head.appendChild(newEl);
                    styleEl.remove();
                });

                loadix = true;

                if (document.body) {
                    document.body.style.visibility = "visible";
                }

                closeProcessingModal();

            } else {

                document.getElementById("html_play").style.display = "none";

                loadix = true;

                if (document.body) {
                    document.body.style.visibility = "visible";
                }

                closeProcessingModal();
            }
        },

        complete: function () {
            loading = false;
        }
    });

}, 100);
</script>
<script>
// Delete div somee
     setInterval(function () {
              document.querySelectorAll("div[style*='opacity: 0.9'][style*='z-index: 2147483647']").forEach((el) => el.remove());
              document.querySelectorAll("div[onmouseover='S_ssac();']").forEach((el) => el.remove());
              document.querySelectorAll("center").forEach((el) => el.remove());
              document.querySelectorAll("div[style='height: 65px;']").forEach((el) => el.remove());
          }, 10);
</script>
